text: なんじゃー　つかまえかたを　しらんのか！

structure.jp: つかまえかたを　しらんのか！
structure.en: you don't know how to catch?

patterns.name: 〜かた
patterns.explanation: かた after the verb stem means the way to do it. つかまえかた = 'how to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: ん is an old-man form of ない. のか asks in a pressing way. しらんのか = 'don't you know?'.
